The '''Mirit system''', also known as the '''Ord Mirit system''', was placed near the [[Pyria system|Pyria]] and [[Venjagga system/Legends|Venjagga systems]] at the edge of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] core. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained [[Ord Mirit]].
